title: The tool, lens, text style and component menus in the panel wear the panel's dropdown
goal: Twelve menus in the right hand panel are still the small system pop-up with up and down arrows while every other panel menu is the drawn dropdown with a chevron: the measure tool's Mode, Snap and Show, the crop tool's Aspect, a lens's Does (on the layer and on the tool), a saved text style's Font, Size and Weight in the Library, and a component's property menus. Draw them all with the same dropdown so the panel reads as one app, keeping what each picks.
notes: Found 2026-10-05 by the-appearance-and-effects-menus-wear-the-same-d: a Picker with no pickerStyle is a system pop-up on the Mac, and the digest grep only looked for pickerStyle(.menu). Sites (bare Picker): ToolInspectors.swift (Mode ~36, Snap ~58, Show ~68, Aspect ~185), LensInspector.swift (Does ~45 and ~118), TextStylePanel.swift (Font/Size/Weight ~393-419, LibraryTextStyleInspector), ComponentPanel.swift (~443, ~1640, ~1693). Pattern: VideoKit.Dropdown(label:value:valueStyle:help:choices: .picking(...)) + .panelHelp(same) + .playtestControl; Mixed reads LayerStyleSelection.mixedText with MixedLook.style. Lower the counts in Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/PanelMenusAreDrawnDropdownsTests.swift stillSystemPopUps as each converts. Click proof: copy Scripts/playtest/appearance-and-effects-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk.json (panelMenu with at: centre/start/end, front: true).
acceptance: Each of the twelve is drawn with the panel dropdown face (same height, chevron, fill and placement as Font and Blending), in light and dark
Each still picks what it picked before, in one undo step where it edits the document
A walk clicks each one with the pointer at its middle and near each end (EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests registers them)
PanelMenusAreDrawnDropdownsTests.stillSystemPopUps is empty, so the guard allows no system pop-up anywhere in the panel

log.note: Built: measure Mode/Show, crop Aspect, lens Does (layer and tool), Library text style Font/Size/Weight, component Place/Variant/choice are VideoKit.Dropdown; Mixed reads on the face in MixedLook.style (mixedOption row removed). Snap is a SegmentedControl: the fields mock says never a select for two options. Added playtestField to Aspect and Does rows. PanelMenusAreDrawnDropdownsTests.stillSystemPopUps is empty; EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests builtSites 8, builtNames + Variant, Shape.

Verified: new tool-and-library-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk clicks each dropdown at centre/start/end and presses both Snap segments, reads each pick back, one undo per pick, dark and light, no flags (13 real captures). 27 of 28 neighbouring walks pass; menu-says-its-whole-value-walk fails on the shadow Kind segmented change from b4c89240, filed as the-whole-value-tooltip-walk-reads-a-shadow-kind. Scripts/test.sh: one run failed AnimatedExportWeighTests (load-sensitive, passes alone, next full run 11399 green); filed find-out-why-a-small-gif-can-come-out-bigger-tha.

left rough: component-choice-one-step-walk passes while its copy shows No properties (canMakeChoice is false at the step whose note says it turns true), so it proves less than its notes claim; not filed, a describe-only walk. left rough: the tool settings capsule over the canvas still uses system pop-ups for Snap and Show; it is not the panel and is excluded from the guard on purpose.

Twelve panel system pop-ups converted: eleven to VideoKit.Dropdown, Snap (two answers) to the segmented control per the fields mock. Guard list empty. Proved by tool-and-library-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk (pointer clicks at centre/start/end, read-back, undo, dark and light, no flags) and Scripts/test.sh green.
